judgment_text:
Prayer : Contempt Petition, filed under Section 11 of the Contempt of Courts Act, to punish the respondent for willful and wantonly disobedience of the orders of this Hon'ble High Court dated 29.03.2023 in W.P. No. 9643/2023.

ORDER

1. Today, the learned Additional Government Pleader appearing for the respondents would submit that the order dated 29.03.2023 in WP.No. 9643 of 2023 was duly complied with by the respondents. In this regard, he had also fded a copy of the order dated 25.09.2025 before this Court. COPY

2. In view of the above, no further order is required. Accordingly, this Contempt Petition is closed.
